I will also buy a few bags of urea and DAP from the village shop for this main maize plot since the soil is tired and does not produce well without help. I will plant the hybrid seed I got from the cooperative because it grows stronger and gives more grain than our local seed, and I will depend entirely on the rains because there is no irrigation water here. My wife and children will work most days on this plot, but I will hire some young men from the village to help during planting and harvest because 2.59 hectares is too much for my family alone.
